newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks fell and nine were flat in three million zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index closing virtually unchanged at 1,566.2 points.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
NFI units rose 0.4 percent in a 3.3 million zloty turnover.
In comparison with their main market fixing nine stocks rose, three fell and two were flat, with NFI units rising 1.4 percent.
